answer: One enforceable rule: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The mesa of work and the saffron of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a forge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
